definitions.explanation: A promise or assurance that something will work or be fulfilled, often for products or services.
A formal declaration that something is true or will happen.

notes:
One of three commonly confused homophones (all read ほしょう).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{保証|ほしょう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to guarantee)
・⟦{保証|ほしょう}{書|しょ}→保証書：09627_hoshousho⟧ (warranty certificate)
・{保証|ほしょう}⟦{期間|きかん}→期間：00229_kikan⟧ (warranty period)
・⟦{保証|ほしょう}{人|にん}→保証人：19978_hoshounin⟧ (guarantor)
・⟦{品質|ひんしつ}{保証|ほしょう}→品質保証：22065_hinshitsuhoshou⟧ (quality assurance)

HOMOPHONES (all ほしょう):
・{保証|ほしょう} - guarantee (for products, promises)
・⟦{保障|ほしょう}→保障：03719_hoshou⟧ - security, protection (for rights, systems)
・⟦{補償|ほしょう}→補償：03720_hoshou⟧ - compensation (for damages)

MEMORY TIP:
{保証|ほしょう} uses {証|しょう} (proof/evidence) - guaranteeing something is true
